mapper.select: SELECT t.id, t.tag_name AS tagName, t.tag_color AS tagColor, COUNT(at.article_id) AS articleCount FROM tag t LEFT JOIN article_tag at ON t.id = at.tag_id LEFT JOIN article a ON at.article_id = a.id AND a.status = 1 AND a.is_deleted = 0 WHERE t.status = 1 AND t.is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY t.id ORDER BY articleCount DESC
